Download `screeny-macos-universal.zip`, unzip it, and move `screeny.app` to Applications.

Supports macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

### First launch

This build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized by Apple. macOS may block it on first launch.

For the screeny app downloaded from this repository, try opening it once, then open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway** for screeny. [Apple’s instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445).

The included `.sha256` file lets you verify the download. Developer ID signing and notarization require an Apple Developer account and are not currently configured.
